mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 1.5%, it signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 1.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), labor market weakness reduces consumer spending capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS > 100k monthly) consistently signals robust corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 100k (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95, it indicates supply chain disruptions that reduce corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods when INDPRO < 95 (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based demand slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce negative 60-day returns in >60% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), the central bank's likely policy response increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 vs baseline).
